title: Add index= parameter to st.tabs to allow restoring active tab after rerun
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

st.tabs has no index= parameter, so the active tab cannot be restored after a rerun triggered by another widget (e.g. language selector). All other stateful widgets like st.radio and st.selectbox support index=. Please add it to st.tabs.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-15754)

This is a feature request (`type:enhancement`) for `st.tabs` to allow programmatically setting and restoring the active tab so it survives reruns triggered by other widgets. Notably, much of this is already implemented on the `develop` branch via the "Dynamic Containers" work: `st.tabs` now accepts `default` (the initially selected tab, by label), `key`, and `on_change` (`"rerun"` or a callable). With `on_change="rerun"` and a `key`, the active tab is tracked and can be read/updated through `st.session_state[key]`, which is exactly the rerun-persistence the issue asks for. The main gap versus the request is that selection is keyed by tab **label** (`default=`) rather than by integer position (`index=`). This is a reasonable triage candidate to either close as resolved by the new stateful tabs API or to scope down to "support selecting a tab by integer index."

### Related Issues

- [#12342 — Add support for dynamic tab badges or persistent tab keys](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12342): Closely related; both stem from `st.tabs` losing the active tab across reruns/updates and ask for a way to persist the selected tab.
- [#11277 — Persist widget identity when key is set, even if the parameters change](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11277): Related state-persistence request relevant to the new keyed/stateful `st.tabs`, since restoring the active tab depends on stable widget identity.
- [#11012 — Preserve session state (e.g. in file, database, or localstorage)](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11012): Broader request for persisting UI/session state across reruns and sessions, the same underlying need that motivates restoring the active tab.
